agent.runner_summary: The adapter accepts one non-empty string per turn, preserves prior user and assistant text as airline.Message history, and calls Agent.StreamResponse.

log_notes: Terminal sessions are JSONL under AIRLINE_SUPPORT_LOG_DIR or logs by default; the simulator adapter does not create or append session logs.
The application records only streamed provider text as its final response; the adapter returns that final text as AssistantMessage.
learning_env_guidance: Use raw string FixedTurn content, not an object. Each simulation begins with an empty conversation history.
A live simulation requires OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. OPENAI_API_KEY is preferred when both are present; OPENAI_MODEL and ANTHROPIC_MODEL are optional overrides.
The internal lookup_booking, baggage_policy, and change_seat tools cannot be RELAI-mocked through the existing exported agent API.
